title: Fix Products Page and Login Regressions (Version 117)

requirements.summary: Fix the Products page regression where no products are displayed. Restore the ProductGrid component's ability to fetch products from the backend and render them in the filterable, paginated grid.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Products page renders the product grid with products fetched from the backend.
Category filters, price slider, and pagination controls function correctly.
Loading and error states are handled gracefully.
No console errors related to product fetching or rendering.

file_operations.description: Review and fix the product fetching logic in ProductGrid. Ensure the useProducts query hook is correctly invoked and that the component properly handles loading, error, and success states. Verify that the filter controls (category, price range) correctly trigger data refetching. Ensure pagination logic correctly slices the filtered product array. Check for any breaking changes in how the backend actor methods are called or how the data is transformed before rendering. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.

Review the useProducts and related product query hooks. Ensure the queryFn correctly calls actor.getAllProducts() and handles the response. Verify that the query is enabled only when the actor is available. Check for any issues with data transformation or caching that might prevent products from appearing. Ensure staleTime and cacheTime settings are appropriate. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.

Review the ProductsPage component to ensure it correctly renders the ProductGrid component and passes any required props. Verify that the page structure hasn't been inadvertently broken in Version 117. Ensure the component is properly memoized and doesn't have rendering issues. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix the admin login regression where both custom username/password authentication and Internet Identity login are not working. Restore successful authentication, session persistence, and Admin Panel access.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can log in using a valid username and password via the custom auth flow.
Admin can log in using Internet Identity.
After successful login, the Admin Panel is accessible and the session persists across page refreshes.
Failed login attempts show appropriate error messages.
No console errors related to authentication or session management.

file_operations.description: Review and fix the AdminLogin component's authentication flows. For custom auth: ensure the username/password form correctly calls the useBackendAuth login mutation and handles the returned session token. Verify password validation and error handling. For Internet Identity: ensure the II login button correctly invokes the useInternetIdentity login method and handles authentication state. Check that both flows properly update auth state and trigger navigation or modal closure on success. Verify that error messages are displayed for failed login attempts. Ensure the component follows the authorization component's frontend usage instructions for Internet Identity integration.

Review the login, register, and logout mutations. Ensure the login mutation correctly calls actor.authenticateUser(username, password) and stores the returned session token using useAuth.setSession. Verify the logout mutation calls actor.logout(sessionToken) and clears local session state. Check for any issues with error handling, toast notifications, or query invalidation after auth state changes. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.

Review the Zustand auth store to ensure session token persistence, username storage, and expiry logic are working correctly. Verify that setSession correctly stores the token and expiry timestamp (24 hours from now). Ensure clearSession removes all auth data from both state and localStorage. Check that the store's persist middleware is correctly configured and that session data survives page refreshes. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.

Review the AdminPage component's authentication gating logic. Ensure it correctly checks both custom auth (via useAuth) and Internet Identity auth (via useInternetIdentity) to determine whether to show the login form or the admin panel. Verify that the admin role check (isCallerAdmin query) is correctly invoked for II users. Ensure the access-denied state is shown only for authenticated non-admin users. Check that the component re-renders appropriately when auth state changes. Ensure the component follows the authorization component's frontend usage instructions for role-based access control.

Review the AdminPanel component to ensure logout functionality works for both custom auth and Internet Identity. Verify that the logout button correctly calls the appropriate logout method based on the active auth mechanism. Ensure that after logout, the user is redirected to the login view and all cached data is cleared. Check that the tabbed navigation and product management components are correctly wired and accessible. Verify the component's usage instructions for any required components before implementing.
